question: Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged off the first Vande Bharat Express Train on which route in South India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mysuru- Chennai**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vande Bharat Express:-**

 
 
• **The Vande Bharat Express is a semi-high-speed train that is manufactured in India. **
 
• It is known for its speed, comfort, and safety features.
 
• The train can travel at speeds of up to 160 km/h and is equipped with features such as automatic doors, Wi-Fi, and GPS.
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged off the first Vande Bharat Express Train on the Chennai-Bengaluru-Mysuru route in South India on November 11, 2022.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Following are the other Vande Bharat Express trains currently operational in India:
 
 
• **New Delhi-Varanasi**
 
• **New Delhi-Katra**
 
• **New Delhi-Chandigarh**
 
• **Mumbai Central-Ahmedabad**
